newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Marine details dividend plans.
newsitem.headline: China Marine details dividend plans.

text.p: China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd on Friday announced it will make a three-for-10 bonus share issue and a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits.
A statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said the plan had been approved by shareholders at a recent meeting.
The exchange rate of its Hong Kong dollar denominated B share cash payment stands at HK$1 to 1.0717 yuan, it said.
The A and B shares will go ex-dividend on June 19, it said.
Its shareholders recently agreed to issue 48 million additional B shares, the company said.
China Marine said it hoped to launch the offer after issuing its 1996 dividend, and use proceeds to fund expansion. It gave no further details.
China Marine posted net profits of 182.31 million yuan for 1996 against 138.9 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
